records.heading: Play Yard and Crib Mattresses Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Fire Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standards for Mattresses; Sold on Amazon by Voomf
records.product: Voomf Play Yard and Crib Mattresses
records.hazard: The recalled mattresses violate the mandatory safety standard for crib mattresses because the mattresses may not adequately fit certain play yards, posing a deadly entrapment hazard. Babies can suffocate in gaps between an undersized mattress, or extra padding, and side walls of a product, especially when the infant’s face becomes trapped against the side and the mattress, preventing the infant from breathing. Furthermore, the full-sized crib mattresses violate the mandatory flammability standard for mattress sets, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire.

methodology.qualifiedEvidence: Independent public reporting about an actual consumer-product injury or death, published strictly before the relevant agency action, with a defensible product and hazard match.
methodology.exclusions: Recall- or alert-announcement coverage, same-day or post-action reporting, hazard-only stories without an actual injury/death, and ambiguous product matches are excluded from lead-time metrics; the separate past-year feed uses the broader rule described below.
methodology.newsSearchPipeline: Recall ingestion → Entity normalization → Query generation → Candidate retrieval → Candidate classification/ranking → Incident clustering
methodology.actionSearchBoundary: No matching product-specific CPSC Recall or Safety Alert was located in the bounded review through August 30, 2026. Not located is not proof that no action exists.

evidenceSearchAudit.cuisinart: A broader search located strong pre-action reporting about the exact product category and injury mechanism, but no independent article that identified a Cuisinart model before the July 2 original recall or August 27 expansion.
evidenceSearchAudit.squishy: Independent pre-alert injury reporting was located from Arizona’s Family and Axios. Post-alert harm articles are retained only as contextual records in the separate past-year feed.
evidenceSearchAudit.excludedCoverage: Recall- and alert-announcement articles remain excluded even when they repeat agency incident counts.
evidenceSearchAudit.pastYear: The primary feed contains only U.S.-reported incidents and excludes recall/agency-announcement articles. International incidents were reviewed but are not counted.
